REFramework (MIT, LICENSE.txt), bundled so the render resolution dropdown works out of the box.

`dinput8.dll` (not in git) is from REFramework nightly 01366
(https://github.com/praydog/REFramework-nightly/releases/tag/nightly-01366-6216ec39697c5b3469e08baf0b98db0baff49c49),
asset `RE7_TDB49.zip`: the build for Resident Evil 7's dx11_non-rt branch (TDB 49). It is the last
nightly with per-game TDB builds; later nightlies ship one REFramework.zip without TDB49. (For RE2's
dx11_non-rt branch, the 2022 TDB66 release didn't start on DirectX 11 under ReShade; this nightly
did.)
